in_marathi.name: Himu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Himu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Himu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'him' which means snow. This name signifies the purity, freshness and calmness of the snow.
